selectionNotes: Select the 2017 ADAM nonconvex model over older convex 164. Viikinkoski et al. (2017), Table 1, uses 22 light curves and two Keck AO images. Its publication-level diameter is 131 ±15 km; Table 4 lists a 128–159 km range for model variants. The selected archive mesh has diameter 153.914 source units and declares 154 ±15 km, so this release uses the archive solution rather than silently substituting the ensemble value. No resolved reflectance mosaic is supplied.
